working_hours.holiday_notes: Open Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Sundays open 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM for prior appointments and emergency care.

services.name: Dental Implants & Full Mouth Rehabilitation
services.description: Permanent, natural-looking tooth replacement using biocompatible titanium implants. Offers Single Tooth, Multiple Teeth, and All-on-4 / All-on-6 full arch replacements by senior implantologist Dr. P. Sudhakar.

services.name: Painless Single-Sitting Root Canal Treatment (RCT)
services.description: Painless treatment to save infected or badly decayed teeth using rotary endodontic equipment, digital apex locators, and sterile procedures in just 1-2 sittings.

services.name: Invisalign & Clear Aligners / Braces
services.description: Custom clear invisible aligners and orthodontic braces (ceramic, metal, and self-ligating) to straighten crooked teeth, close gaps, and correct bite alignment for teens and adults.

services.name: Cosmetic Dentistry & Smile Designing
services.description: Personalized smile makeovers including porcelain and composite veneers, 1-hour laser teeth whitening, gap closures, and gummy smile correction by Dr. K. Mounika.

services.name: Dental Crowns & Bridges
services.description: High-strength, natural-looking metal-free Zirconia crowns with 5 to 15-year warranty, CAD/CAM ceramic crowns, and aesthetic dental bridges to restore chewing function.

services.name: Teeth Cleaning, Scaling & Polishing
services.description: Advanced ultrasonic cleaning to remove stubborn plaque, tartar, coffee/tobacco stains, and cure bleeding gums (gingivitis), followed by protective fluoride polishing.

services.name: Wisdom Tooth Extraction & Oral Surgery
services.description: Gentle, painless extraction of impacted wisdom teeth and diseased teeth with minimal post-op discomfort and rapid healing.

services.name: Pediatric / Kids Dentistry
services.description: Child-friendly dental care including preventive fluoride coatings, cavity fillings, painless milk tooth root canal (pulpectomy), and habit-breaking appliances.

services.name: Dentures (Full & Partial)
services.description: Custom-fitted lightweight flexible dentures, BPS dentures, and implant-retained overdentures providing superior grip and natural chewing ability.

services.name: Emergency Toothache & Dental Trauma Care
services.description: Immediate relief for severe tooth pain, broken or cracked teeth, gum abscess, facial swellings, or dental trauma.

packages.name: Complete Dental Checkup & Digital X-Ray
packages.description: Comprehensive oral examination, digital RVG X-ray, and personalized treatment plan discussion with senior specialist.

packages.name: Ultrasonic Scaling & Polishing Package
packages.description: Full mouth ultrasonic cleaning, stain removal, and protective fluoride polishing.

packages.name: Single-Sitting RCT Package
packages.description: Complete painless root canal procedure with advanced rotary tools and digital apex locators.

packages.name: Dental Implant Consultation Package
packages.description: 3D bone evaluation, implant suitability assessment, and treatment planning by Dr. P. Sudhakar.

faqs.question: Where is Smile Dental and Implant Centre located?
faqs.answer: We are located on the 1st Floor, Above K. Rathod Jewellers, Sri Ram Nagar Colony, Near Kapra Circle, Saket Road, ECIL, Secunderabad – 500062. Landmark: Right above K. Rathod Jewellers near Kapra Circle.

faqs.question: What are the clinic timings?
faqs.answer: Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM. On Sundays, we are open from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM by prior appointment.

faqs.question: Who are the chief doctors at Smile Dental?
faqs.answer: Dr. P. Sudhakar, BDS, MDS (Senior Consultant, Periodontist & Implantologist with over 15 years experience) and Dr. K. Mounika, BDS, PGDCC (Consultant Cosmetic Dentist & Facial Aesthetics Specialist).

faqs.question: Is Root Canal Treatment (RCT) painful?
faqs.answer: No! At Smile Dental, we perform Root Canal Treatments using advanced local anesthesia, rotary endodontics, and digital apex locators, making the procedure virtually painless and comfortable.

faqs.question: How long does a Dental Implant procedure take?
faqs.answer: Placing a single dental implant usually takes just 20 to 30 minutes under local anesthesia. The implant integrates with the jawbone over 2 to 3 months, after which a permanent aesthetic crown (Zirconia/Ceramic) is placed.

faqs.question: Do I need to book an appointment before visiting?
faqs.answer: Prior appointment booking is highly recommended to ensure zero waiting time and prompt consultation with the specialist doctor. However, walk-in dental emergencies are always accommodated immediately.

faqs.question: Are clear aligners (Invisalign) available?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer digital orthodontic scans and custom clear invisible aligners as well as ceramic/metal braces to align teeth without uncomfortable wires.

faqs.question: What are the payment options and do you offer EMI?
faqs.answer: We accept UPI (GPay/PhonePe/Paytm), Cash, Debit/Credit Cards, and 0% Interest EMI financing options for major treatments like Dental Implants, Braces, and Smile Makeovers.
